rule: A disproven premise remains searchable until explicit supersession evidence changes its scope. Future work must consult this registry before reintroducing a rejected assumption.

entries.premise: ConnectivityDiagnosticsManager callback registration means Lite Observer will receive useful connectivity/data-stall callbacks.
entries.safe_alternative: Use NetworkCallback/NetworkCapabilities/LinkProperties in Lite mode; activate ConnectivityDiagnostics only when KINLINK actually qualifies as a connectivity provider.
entries.supersession_condition: Android platform contract changes or KINLINK operates as an eligible active VPN/carrier/Wi-Fi provider and target-device proof confirms callback delivery.

entries.premise: Android link bandwidth estimate can be shown as experienced connection quality or a 100/100 user score.
entries.safe_alternative: Treat framework bandwidth as a technical prior; prioritize user incident, interruptions, stalls and sustained local history.
entries.supersession_condition: Never supersede as a general rule; only a separate measured QoE metric with explicit semantics may be added.

entries.safe_alternative: Describe it only as Android metric refresh; any later improvement is correlational until stronger causal evidence exists.
entries.supersession_condition: A different active intervention with controlled before/after evidence proves causal benefit.

entries.premise: Static XML/layout checks are sufficient responsive UI proof.
entries.safe_alternative: Require rendered emulator matrix plus semantic/manual visual counter-audit and target-device evidence for field promotion.
entries.supersession_condition: None; static checks may complement but not replace rendered proof.

entries.premise: A recent release traceability table is the full KINLINK cahier des charges.
entries.safe_alternative: Always load immutable A + deep B + append-only C before scope/progress decisions.
entries.supersession_condition: Only an explicit, user-authorized product rescope can change the full ambition.

entries.premise: Gmail send API success or an intermediate PDF message is enough to consider communication complete.
entries.safe_alternative: Explicit START/END transitions, provider ACK/readback, durable ledger and CLOSED state.
entries.supersession_condition: Only a new communication protocol with equivalent or stronger provider-ack proof.

entries.premise: After a watchdog closes an interrupted tranche it should automatically open another START even though no product worker is running.
entries.safe_alternative: Watchdog closes stale tranche and leaves NEXT_UNCOMMITTED_ACTION; foreground worker opens a fresh START before substantive work.
entries.supersession_condition: A future automation is explicitly authorized to execute substantive product work after START.

entries.premise: Targeting Android 17 means KINLINK should request local-network permission at startup even when current features only observe default-network state or reach public Internet endpoints.
entries.safe_alternative: Classify operations first; request ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK just in time only for a direct LAN feature that requires it. Core observer/public-Internet diagnostics remain functional without a gratuitous LAN prompt.
entries.supersession_condition: Only a future default-on feature that genuinely requires direct LAN sockets/discovery and has explicit user-approved product scope may change the request timing.
